en: What is this place...?
I've never seen her before.
I wonder if I can communicate with her...
Hey, do you know where this is? I'm kind of lost...
Whoa...!
So you want a fight?!
What is this...?
A shard of mirror...?
Something is glowing inside it...
Ugh...!
I remember! I went to Lapis Market to get ready for the tea party...
We went through a lot trying to find the Jewel Witch.
Then I got dragged into that strange mirror.
Bazira, Rims, and the other witches...
I wonder if they're looking for me by now.
Looking for me... for... me...
Who... am I?
What was my name...?
No. I shouldn't overthink it.
What matters is that touching the glowing mirror brought my memories back.
I don't know whether this is a curse or some kind of magic...
My name and the rest of my memories must be inside the other mirror shards.
I should look for the other shards.
I can feel it. This is part of my memory too.
A realm that tears a witch's mind into pieces... What kind of place is this?
All right. My head is still foggy, but...
I think my memories are coming back, little by little.
Once I have all my memories back, then...
This realm must have a witch who owns it too, right?
I'll ask her to let me out of here.
Hello there, creepy friend.
That look... Are you copying me?
Wow... Have I ever screamed like that...?
Right. This is my face.
But I still can't remember my name...
It'd help if you could tell me.
Your name is Sil.
That's right. My name is Sil.
Sil, who lives in a little house. Sil, who loves cutting with scissors.
Sil, who lives in a house spacious enough for her. Sil, who loves sewing.
Yes. I remember everything now.
If you're part of me, could you stop standing there and come back?
Be careful. She's coming.
What?
Hello, Sil.
Who were you talking to?
Nothing important. I was having a little talk with myself.
Oh. I know what you mean.
I talk to countless versions of myself too.
What did you say?
Who are you, anyway?
Are you the witch who rules this realm?
You're asking who I am...?
Hehe... What a funny joke.
I'm Nahatra.
Your friend. The Dream Witch. The seed of the garden.
All right. I'll leave that for now.
Could you explain where we are?
Sil, what are you talking about all of a sudden?
This is the garden. Our garden.
Look. If a place this beautiful isn't the garden, what else could it be?
The garden isn't some place full of cheap imitations.
What do you mean, Sil?
I don't know who you are, but...
You'd better let me out of here.
It looks like you need a little more time.
I'll let you spend some time somewhere quiet.
Don't worry. I'll call you back when the tea party begins... Hehe...!
What?
I can't believe the floor gave way...!
Where am I falling to?!
This darkness... It's like the nightmare...
No... deeper than that... Could this be outside the garden...?
S-Somebody help me!
There is no need to shout. I can hear you perfectly well, Sil.
Who...? Nahatra...?
Sorry to disappoint you, but I am not Nahatra.
You're...
Take my hand.
Phew... Thanks for helping me.
Yes, feel free to thank me as much as you like.
You were in serious danger, after all.
But who are you...?
What? You do not remember me? We met at the tea party.
Sorry, but I really don't remember.
Hah... To think I must introduce myself twice.
I suppose it cannot be helped. Your memories are still fragmented...
I am Shasha. Shasha, the Jewel Witch.
Don't ever forget me again. Got it?
The Jewel Witch...
Oh! You're the missing witch Bazira was looking for!
As I thought, Bazira has been looking for me.
Then go to Bazira at once and tell her.
Tell her the most beautiful witch in the garden is trapped inside a mirror!
...Sorry, but I'm trapped too.
How dare you!
When speaking to me, your only answers are "Yes" or "Understood"!
What's with her...?
All right... Let's sort out what's going on first.
So, how did you get dragged in here?
...A mirror.
As always, I was about to admire my beautiful reflection in the mirror...
But the reflection wasn't mine.
There was someone else inside the mirror, and the moment I felt dizzy...
When I came to, I was inside this mirror world.
So the mirror really is the gateway.
The one who attacked me earlier must be behind this, right?
It looked like it was imitating Nahatra...
Yes. That thing is imitating Nahatra's form.
Not only that. Everything in this realm is an imitation of the garden.
Sil! I cannot tolerate such a complete lack of aesthetic sense!
We must teach the Mirror Witch a lesson. You will help me!
The Mirror Witch?
What else would you call her?
A witch who uses mirrors to imitate everything...
A fitting name, is it not?
Fair enough.
What does the Mirror Witch want? Why did she abduct us?
Could it have something to do with that tea party she mentioned?
I haven't figured that out yet either.
But it doesn't seem as though she simply wants to hurt us.
I wish we had some kind of clue.
This is the only thing I've found since I got here.
This is...!
I see. So that is how it is...
Did you figure something out?
This is a piece of the Mirror Witch.
A piece of the Mirror Witch? This?
The power inside this shard unquestionably belongs to the Mirror Witch.
Why would she scatter pieces of herself everywhere?
She didn't scatter herself. She broke apart.
It was probably the backlash from pushing herself too hard to imitate Nahatra.
Trying to imitate the entire garden using her own body...
A mere ordinary witch could never withstand that. Hmph.
Hmm...
But thanks to that, I think we can turn her power against her.
...Hah!
I extracted power from the mirror shard to protect your mind.
For a while, your mind should no longer be torn apart.
Oh, that's impressive.
However, there's a limit to what we can do with the shards we have now.
Besides, gathering the Mirror Witch's power should help us make our way through this world.
...It seems we'll need to collect more mirror shards.
You will assist me as my attendant!
I don't remember ever becoming your attendant.
But if you're asking to work together, I'm in.
Good. We have no time to waste, so we should begin preparing at once.
For now, we'll use this little storeroom as our base.
A-a little storeroom...
What? Would you prefer somewhere larger?
No, this is fine.
You said we need more mirror shards, right?
I'll go find some. I want to look around this realm anyway.
Hmph. In that case, I'll leave it to you.
This is...
This place looks like an imitation of Fiena's flower garden.
There isn't a single bee or butterfly in sight.
If the Mirror Witch created Fiena's realm...
Does that mean she made a fake Fiena too?
Hello, Fiena...?
You do look a lot like the usual Fiena...
Another mirror shard?
Shasha was right...
She really did use pieces of herself to create those reflections.
Whoa?! What is this?
Is this... a memory stored in the mirror?
Whose memory is it...?
No, no...
No matter what I do, I can't put it back together...
My realm... my place... where I belong...
Why can't we do it...? Is it because I'm not enough...?
Maybe it's all our fault.
No. We didn't choose to be born like this.
No. It is all our fault.
Look at us. We're shattered into pieces.
Was that... the Mirror Witch's memory?
And... this churning feeling...
For just a moment, it felt as though the mirror world and I were connected.
Is it because of the power in this mirror shard?
What are you doing?
Sil, you may thank me!
The barrier I created will protect this place.
Oh. Does that mean this place is safe now?
Yes. But it will not last long.
So we must find a way to deal with the Mirror Witch as soon as possible.
About that...
Well done, Sil! You found a shard.
As your master, I commend your efforts.
But... only one?
If you're unhappy, you can go run around and find one yourself.
Getting this back here was no easy job.
How dare you!
I told you to always be humble when speaking to me!
You never said that.
How dare you!!
If I say I said it, then I said it. Got it?
Yeah, yeah.
Shasha, when I got this shard...
I caught a glimpse of the Mirror Witch's memories.
And the way she looked in those memories was...
She was creepy, but she also looked fragile and unstable.
What if we gathered all the shards and returned them to their owner...?
Could the Mirror Witch become whole again?
I respect your compassion.
But... if you've looked around this world, you must understand.
Her realm has been shattered beyond recognition.
A few returned shards will never be enough to repair it.
Not unless some miracle occurs.
I see.
For now, focus on completing this artifact.
After Fiena, is this place copying Abigail's farm?
A flower garden, a farm...
Maybe she's recreating the realms of the witches attending the tea party.
It might have something to do with the Mirror Witch saying she'd hold a tea party.
Oh, a mirror shard.
Am I going to see another one of the Mirror Witch's memories?
It makes me nauseous every time, so I'm not exactly eager...
Hmm, but I have no choice. I need the shards...
Look at the garden beyond the mirror.
The garden is a world made of pieces too.
A place where different realms barely hold together...
Maybe our world could become a garden too.
...How?
There is no way.
We're nothing but a broken mirror.
No. There is a way.
There is still a way for us?
Nahatra...
I want to become Nahatra.
You want to become Nahatra?
Do you want to become <style=glitchy>!#@</style>Nahat<style=glitchy>^@</style>?
Buil<style=glitchy>^%!@#!</style>d a garden like her<style=glitchy>$%@!</style>
I want to beco<style=glitchy>%!@</style>me Na<style=glitchy>@!#</style>ra
...I want to.
Ugh...
Aaaaaaah!!!!
Look at the figure in this mirror.
It's reflecting me!
I can see myself in it...
My reflection...
That's... not your reflection.
You are right on time.
Welcome back, Sil.
Canele?!
How did you get here? You really are Canele, right?
I never thought I'd be this happy to see you...!
Don't be so dramatic, Sil.
How did you get in here?
Did the mirror drag you in too?
I have my own ways.
A tiny crack had formed, so I slipped through it.
A crack...?
Yes. A crack just large enough for one cat to pass through.
It seems to have formed because of all the trouble you caused in here.
Thanks to you, I ended up with the tiresome job of messenger.
If Nahatra hadn't asked, I would have refused.
You really are something...
Well, you came. So... thanks.
Did you talk to Shasha?
I was just telling her what has happened so far.
It seems no one in the garden can tell what's happening here.
Shasha was remarkably composed.
Even though she's considerably weakened.
Weakened? Really? I had no idea.
Not enough to warrant concern.
More importantly, listen to the news Canele brought.
What news?
Not especially good news.
No matter what we try, the garden cannot interfere with this place.
Not even Nahatra.
What?!
That's quite a face.
Easy for you to say...
Calm yourself, Sil. Do not forget your elegance.
Phew... All right.
At least the crack that let Canele through sounds like good news.
I wonder if it really is.
What now?
If we make the crack bigger, couldn't we use it to return to the garden?
Sil, think about when a mirror develops cracks.
Well...
When it... breaks...?
Exactly. Canele is saying this mirror world will soon break apart.
With us inside it.
...You're joking, right?
Don't worry, Sil.
We only need to hold a tea party. Then this realm will stabilize.
A tea party with Nahatra. That's what you always do, isn't it?
Ugh... I have to hold a tea party with that thing?
Why not?
...Good point. I never thought of it that way.
Even if she is fake, Nahatra is Nahatra, and the garden is the garden.
So a tea party is still a tea party.
Phew. So there is a solution after all.
Then the realm can keep its current form, and no more cracks will appear.
Wait. That means...
It seems you've realized.
If we hold a tea party with the Mirror Witch and stabilize this place...
This will become one complete space without any cracks.
And then we will be trapped in this world.
You mean we'd have to live in this mirror world forever?
No! I refuse to live in a world where every sofa and bed is hard!
And on top of that, with someone this stuck-up...
Anyway, I don't want that!
I don't care if this realm collapses. I'll tear open a crack and get home somehow!
Do you understand what you are saying, Sil?
The fact that even Nahatra cannot interfere here means...
This place does not belong to the garden.
If we fail to escape before the realm collapses...
This is only a guess, but I doubt it would end with our very essence merely shattering.
I know that much.
But no matter what, I refuse to spend my life trapped here.
I'll flip this fake tea party over, table and all!
...Hehe.
Sil, I am beginning to like you.
Good. Now that the direction is set, all that's left is to create the masterpiece.
Masterpiece?
Sil, show it to Canele.
Oh, you mean this.
A witch fragment.
Yes. I will use it to create a powerful artifact capable of opposing the Mirror Witch.
What are you planning to make?
Think of it as an artifact that can resist the power of the mirror world.
If we're going to bring down this world and its tea party, we may as well do it properly.
My attendant is collecting the shards, so it will be finished soon.
Attendant...? Your dignity has really fallen since I last saw you, Sil.
I told you, I'm not her attendant.
By the way, Canele, what are you going to do now?
I suppose I'll just sit back and watch...
...you struggle to stay alive.
You blasted cat...
If you've got nothing better to do, come up with an idea too.
Don't order me around.
That refusal to bow so easily...
Cats truly are proud creatures.
You understand.
Right. You two kindred spirits can enjoy each other's company.
I'm off to struggle for my life, then.
